findings: The remaining diagonal stamp was dominated by the repeated metalness mask: reducing albedo contrast, AO or normal scale alone did not remove it in the actual scene.
A diagnostic-only zero-metalness comparison removed the stamp; the production finish preserves subdued source metalness variation as painted weathered metal. Bitumen is explicitly dielectric.
Metric source UVs, pinned CC0 maps, shared texture identity and source geometry are unchanged. No texture, draw or independent clock was added.
Actual desktop and mobile production frames show quiet roof surfaces without the preceding diagonal pattern. Both settled pause checks drew zero frames over 2.2 seconds.
limitations: This is an authored surface finish, not an observation of the actual roof material.
Screenshots were opened and visually compared; no claim of pixelwise perceptual equivalence or SimCity-level acceptance is made.
Diagnostic property ablations ran only in a separate test browser and were removed by reload before production captures.
The mobile resize exposed a separate detail-cache retry defect, fixed and verified in cache-viewport-resize-20260909.json.
Whole-city art, integrated motion and public release remain separate gates.
